tasks.label: N64: Compile & Flash to X7
tasks.command: flatpak-spawn --host distrobox enter n64-dev -T -- bash -lc 'cd "/home/deck/n64_test_project" && export N64_INST=/n64_toolchain && make && TERM=xterm UNFLoader -l -d -r /home/deck/n64_test_project/n64-demo.z64'

tasks.label: N64: Clean Build
tasks.command: flatpak-spawn --host distrobox enter n64-dev -T -- bash -lc 'cd "/home/deck/n64_test_project" && export N64_INST=/n64_toolchain && make clean'

tasks.label: N64: Run in ares Emulator
tasks.command: cd /home/deck/n64_test_project && ./build.sh && flatpak-spawn --host setsid flatpak run --share=network dev.ares.ares --gdb-server=2159 /home/deck/n64_test_project/n64-demo.z64
